scope: OS module implementation descriptions; explicitly exclude comparison, vulnerabilities, behavior graphs, condition records and summary repair
hypothesis: Registration-site evidence packaging improves correctly attributed and doubly located interface implementation descriptions under a fixed source budget, beyond ordinary table lookup and lexical retrieval.
actual_cost_measure: provider CNY balance delta; official peak USD rates only estimate, no assumed exchange rate
evaluation: Compiler-executed projected original designated initializers supply role-to-function facts. Universal Ctags independently supplies implementation spans. No model judge. Correct binding coverage, errors, explicit unknown, omissions, and input-backed two-location evidence coverage scored separately. Chinese responsibility prose is preserved but not semantically scored.
reference_limits: Only explicit identifier-valued function-pointer initializer entries; no conditional compilation resolution, dynamic rebinding, runtime OS ability, total interface completeness, arbitrary prose correctness or judge benefit.
continuation_gate: Both RT-Thread repeats must improve complete-evidence coverage at least 0.10 over the strongest baseline, with no additional wrong bindings or output budget failures; both confirmation repositories must retain positive gain in both repeats. Cost <= 1.5x strongest baseline for generated final descriptions. Equality of inputs/outputs or reference validity failure defeats method claim.
stop: One frozen protocol, no prompt retuning, no replacing tasks or denominator; failures remain in denominators. Confirmation tasks run even after a failed development gate to characterize the failure, never to rescue eligibility. Budget/balance breach stops dependent calls and records resource exhaustion.
matching: Same pinned source universe, task, generator, serializer and output budget. Contexts intentionally differ and actual bytes/tokens reported. Production reader gets one optional allocation call and real read_file behavior; others get deterministic context assembly. This is a bounded production source-reading adapter, not an end-to-end full report replication. CodeWiki official C component extraction is run unchanged, followed by common BM25 selection; not full hierarchical CodeWiki.
cache: Exactly identical model request bodies share one raw response across arms; repeated sampling uses independent repeat ids. Distinct generation repeats are not independent repositories.
exposure: RT-Thread exposed in previous kernel research; no matching RIOT/Mynewt repository usage found in read historical documents, but history visibility changed during external deletion and pretraining contamination is not excluded. Confirmation task names frozen before outputs; source schemas inspected for feasibility.
mechanism_boundary: Only initializer registration ownership and ordinary symbol definition windows. No new behavior/call graph, state card, predicates, multi-stage compression or local patching. Ordinary lookup equivalence is a predeclared reason to reject novelty.
